browser_trigger.explanation: controlTick invoked stopLocal(true) while holding forward and focused; motionReady rejected stale telemetry. DISARM sent by the application, not a retained manual click.

delivery_observation.interpretation: Frames with approximately 60 ms ESP time steps arrived in a burst after a 287.9 ms browser receive gap. This supports delivery/queueing delay, but does not isolate ESP HTTP task, Wi-Fi/TCP, laptop network stack or browser message dispatch.

esp_stop.definition: Time since the last CMD UART send, not simply WebSocket disconnection.
esp_stop.note: ESP stop reason and browser local-stop trace both observed; unsynchronized clocks and buffered delivery do not identify their exact physical ordering.

result.timing_limit: Browser arrival times are not electrical/physical stop latency.

retention.note: Recorder was left running from prior run04; old samples were evicted by bounded buffers. The immediate trigger and preceding/following events remain available; this is not a new standalone 1 m accuracy trial.

decision.next: Investigate delivery latency under the existing limits; do not increase timeout thresholds based only on this event. Keep this automatic-stop event separate from the earlier manual-DISARM UI report.
